title: When the Homecoming Burns
author: Silas Yarrow
blurb: Freya Iversen, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, has spent three years being so careful it hurts. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before graduation.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
